summary.text: Blood path dao marks are law traces of blood path. In an immortal aperture they remodel the environment for blood path life forms; on a body they amplify blood path methods, can shield against blasts, and can be spent as the true cost of certain blood path killer moves.

claims.text: After the blood poison kerria earthly calamity, Hu Immortal blessed land gained many blood path dao marks. Those marks remodel the blessed land’s environment and create the foundation for blood sickle grass and red axe flowers to grow, and they also let Fang Yuan plan to raise blood stripe foxes with higher reproduction than earlier fox groups.
General dao marks and attainment levels are covered on dao marks and attainment.
When Song Zi Xing detonates Blazing Demonic Immortal Dan Qiao’s corpse, the blood path dao marks in his body shine brightly and leave him unharmed at the center of the explosion.

Blood demon body separation expends the body’s blood path dao marks. Those marks are why the clone can pass off as the real person; without paying that dao mark price it could not. Even if a limb is regrown later, the new arm is blank because the blood path dao marks on it were used up, and Song Zi Xing would have to regain lost marks from calamities and tribulations. After that ambush most of the blood path dao marks on his body were destroyed.

After the same blood poison kerria calamity added blood path dao marks, Hu Immortal blessed land’s environment changed drastically and became suitable for some blood path life forms. The dwindling zhi forest turned into a lush blood zhi forest while earlier flora such as chestnut flowers and milk tea flowers were wiped out.
Among Fang Yuan’s dao marks, blood path dao marks number about twelve thousand, obtained from Hei Fan grotto-heaven’s blood path Gu Immortal Zheng Tuo.

Blood beasts are path beasts born from heaven and earth, created using natural blood path dao marks, rather than normal reproduction. When Wu Yong clears the ambush at blood tide pit, the dense blood path dao marks there vanish and the pit becomes an ordinary pit.
